summary: Roughly a third of this surface matches: the composer's model selector, send button, attach-button-flagged-unbacked, and execute toggle all render correctly in the fresh/idle state. Everything else that makes the fresh state feel designed is either entirely unimplemented (headline, SUGGESTED prompts, composer pill, topbar placeholder text, animate-to-floor transition) or actively wrong (the rail's + button skips the prototype's new-session dialog and POSTs a blank session immediately). The +new dialog — title/name field, session|workspace tabs, AGENT BLUEPRINT/EXPERT PACK/WORKSPACE selects, CREATE SESSION button — has zero implementation in apps/web/src despite every data source it needs (GET /v1/agent-blueprints, GET /v1/expert-packs, GET /v1/workspaces, POST /v1/sessions, POST /v1/workspaces) already being live and reachable.

items.element: Composer vertical position — centered mid-canvas before the first turn
items.proto_truth: Layout is a flex column: header (64px) -> ribbon (34px) -> headline wrapper (flex-grow:1, flex-basis:0%) -> fixed-height composer block (345px, containing pill+frame+SUGGESTED+footer) -> bottom spacer (flex-grow:1, flex-basis:0px). With both flex:1 siblings present, the composer block sits roughly mid-viewport (measured composer frame rect: x=440,y=372,w=860,h=89 inside a 1440x900 viewport — vertical center ~416/900 = 46%), not pinned to the floor.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/composer.css:9-21 — `.composer { margin: auto auto 0; }` inside apps/web/src/shell/appshell.css:37-48 `.shell__content` (flex column). The code comment explicitly states intent: "holds the composer against the bottom of the viewport rather than the bottom of the text." There is no top/bottom flex-grow spacer pair and no idle-vs-active layout branch. Screenshot apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/app-fresh-session.png shows the composer pinned at the very bottom (y≈756-880 of 900) even with zero messages.
items.backend_surface: unbacked (pure client layout)
items.fix_hint: Give the idle/no-messages state a top spacer (flex:1) above the composer and a bottom spacer (flex:1, transition: flex-grow) below it; drop both to flex-grow:0 once the transcript has content, matching the prototype's spacer pair.

items.element: Composer animate-to-floor transition on first turn
items.proto_truth: The bottom spacer div carries `transition: flex-grow 0.46s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` (measured via getComputedStyle) — when the first message starts a turn, that spacer's flex-grow animates from 1 to 0, sliding the composer from mid-canvas down to the floor over 460ms as the transcript takes the vacated space.
items.app_evidence: No such transition exists anywhere in apps/web/src/composer/composer.css or apps/web/src/shell/appshell.css — impossible for it to exist given finding above (composer is ALWAYS floor-pinned via `margin:auto auto 0`, so there is nothing to animate from).
items.backend_surface: unbacked (pure client animation, but its trigger condition — "a turn started" — is powered by POST /v1/sessions/{id}/messages returning and messages.length transitioning 0→1)
items.fix_hint: Land together with the centered-composer fix above: the same spacer pair whose flex-grow animates is what produces this transition for free.

items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Rail.tsx:292-298 — `<button aria-label="New session" onClick={() => newSession?.()}>` calls straight through to `startNewSession()` -> `createAndSelectSession()` in apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx:481-508, which immediately calls `client.createSession({})` (POST /v1/sessions) with no title, no blueprint, no expert pack — no dialog is shown at all. The kit's `Modal` component (apps/web/src/kit/Modal.tsx) exists and is exercised only in apps/web/src/kit/KitGallery.tsx (a dev-only gallery page), never wired to this button.

items.backend_surface: GET /v1/agent-blueprints — client method `agentBlueprints()` in apps/core/src/client/agent_blueprint_client.ts. Live-verified reachable: `curl http://127.0.0.1:17900/v1/agent-blueprints` returns a real blueprint ("earthscope-gnss-region"). NOTE: POST /v1/sessions itself has no blueprint field (CreateSessionInput = {title, workspace_id} only) — binding a chosen blueprint would need a follow-up call, likely `setSessionBlueprintBinding` (apps/core/src/client/agent_blueprints.ts).
items.fix_hint: Populate the select from client.agentBlueprints(); after createSession() succeeds, call the session-blueprint binding endpoint with the chosen id before navigating in.

items.element: Composer mode row — "ask" toggle/approval-mode button, fresh state
items.proto_truth: Always visible alongside "execute": circle-question icon + "ask" text, JetBrains Mono 11.5px, color var(--t-mu) (or highlighted when active, per other captured session states).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx:316-346 — the button is gated on `approvalMode && onApprovalModeChange`; `approvalMode` comes from `detail?.approval_mode` (SessionView.tsx:804), which is null until a real session record has loaded. With no active session, only the "execute" button (Composer.tsx:348-357) renders. Screenshot apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/app-fresh-session.png shows "+  ▷ execute" only, no "ask".
items.backend_surface: session.approval_mode is a real field (PATCH /v1/sessions/{id}) but genuinely does not exist before a session is created — the prototype still shows the control pre-session using a client-only default ("ask"), which the app's `mode` state (Composer.tsx:102, defaults to 'ask') already tracks internally, it's just not exposed as a button.
items.fix_hint: Render the ask/execute pair unconditionally using the local `mode` state; treat the approval-mode MENU (the extra ask/auto-edits/bypass/ai-review picker) as the part that stays disabled/hidden until a session + approval_mode exist, rather than hiding the whole button.
